title: Review and Recalibration of Foreign Manpower Mix to Enable Better Opportunities for Local Workforce
what_it_is: Review and Recalibration of Foreign Manpower Mix to Enable Better Opportunities for Local Workforce

sections.label: Employment Pass salary updates
sections.summary: EP and S Pass qualifying salaries are updated regularly, with new EP applicants aged 23 needing at least S$5,600, and the Complementarity Assessment Framework refreshed annually.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: For instance, we regularly update our Employment Pass (EP) and S Pass qualifying salaries to keep pace with local wage growths, and it avoids undercutting local salaries.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: New EP applicants aged 23 years old must earn at least S$5,600 to qualify, and this is significantly above the median wage of our fresh graduates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: We also refresh the Complementarity Assessment Framework for EP applications annually, keeping in line with market conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: For example, we will add or remove occupations on the Shortage Occupation List based on industry shortages and industries’ efforts to develop the local pipeline.

sections.label: Foreign-owned companies and local workforce
sections.summary: Foreign-owned companies are 20% of all companies but employ one-third of the resident workforce, and MOM will review policies and invest in the local workforce.

sentences.text: While foreign-owned companies account for 20% of all companies in Singapore, they employ one-third of the resident workforce, and these include our fresh graduates as well.
MOM will continue to review our policies holistically.
We will continue to invest heavily in our local workforce to support Singaporeans across all economic climates.
